title.en: Reviewing AI-assisted code: reproduce the late response first
title.zh: 审阅 AI 辅助代码：先复现“旧响应覆盖新输入”

summary.en: A deterministic A → AB experiment, why debounce is insufficient, and what cancellation can actually guarantee.
summary.zh: 用 A → AB 的确定性实验审阅异步代码：防抖为什么不够，取消请求又能保证什么。

basis.en: Review of the existing latest-request.mjs teaching example. Its four tests were rerun on 1 November 2026. This is an exercise for reviewing AI-assisted code, not a claimed production incident or evidence that a particular AI generated the defect.
basis.zh: 依据既有 latest-request.mjs 教学示例整理，2026-11-01 重新运行其 4 项测试。本文是审阅 AI 辅助代码的练习，不虚构生产故障，也不声称某个 AI 曾生成这一缺陷。

paragraphs.en: Send query A, then AB. Resolve AB first with [new], and A later with [old]. An implementation that renders every successful response ends with old. The required outcome is that the newest query owns the visible state, regardless of completion order.
paragraphs.zh: 先发查询 A，再发 AB；让 AB 先返回 [new]，A 后返回 [old]。如果每次成功都直接渲染，最后会显示 old。验收条件应写成：无论完成顺序如何，页面只接受最新查询的结果。

paragraphs.en: The existing fixture exposes resolve and reject functions instead of using random delays. This makes success order, rejection order and disposal repeatable without a server.
paragraphs.zh: 既有测试夹具把 resolve 和 reject 暴露出来，不用随机延时制造竞态。成功顺序、失败顺序和卸载时机都可以重复控制，不需要启动服务。

paragraphs.en: Debounce reduces how often work starts. It cannot order work that has already started. AbortController asks an adapter to stop; a cache or test adapter may ignore the signal. A sequence ID decides whether a returned result still has permission to render.
paragraphs.zh: 防抖减少启动次数，不能改变已经发出的请求的完成顺序。AbortController 请求适配器停止工作，但缓存或测试适配器可能忽略 signal。递增序号则决定返回结果是否仍有权更新页面。

paragraphs.en: The example uses cancellation and a sequence guard together. Clearing the input advances the sequence before returning to idle; dispose also advances it. Guarding only the success branch would still let an old failure replace current loading feedback.
paragraphs.zh: 示例同时使用取消和序号保护。清空输入时，先递增序号再进入 idle；dispose 也递增序号。只保护成功分支仍不够，否则旧失败可能覆盖当前加载提示。

title.en: 03 / Read the assertions, then run them

paragraphs.en: The four cases cover a late success that ignores cancellation; stale versus current rejection; clearing and disposal; and empty results. All four passed in this review. They verify the controller, not DOM behavior, HTTP validation or application authorization.
paragraphs.zh: 4 个用例分别覆盖忽略取消的旧成功、旧失败与当前失败、清空与卸载、空结果。本轮全部通过。它们验证控制器，不验证 DOM 交互、HTTP 响应校验或业务授权。

title.en: 04 / What I take from this exercise

paragraphs.en: For AI-assisted development, the useful review question is not whether the function looks complete. Ask which event owns the right to change state. A prompt can request explicit states and tests, but passing tests must be checked against the actual failure sequence.
paragraphs.zh: 使用 AI 辅助开发时，我更关注“谁在什么时刻有权更新状态”。提示词可以要求补齐状态和测试，但验收仍要回到具体失败顺序，不能把生成了测试当成已经覆盖问题。

paragraphs.en: Next, add an adapter that validates HTTP status and payload shape, then check loading announcements and focus in the browser. For writes, canceling a browser request does not roll back a server transaction.
paragraphs.zh: 下一步可以补上 HTTP 状态与响应结构校验，再到浏览器检查加载播报和焦点。对于写请求，浏览器取消也不等于服务器事务回滚。
